# Image fixtures

`rainbow-451x461.heic` is a real HEVC-compressed HEIC fixture copied from
`strukturag/libheif` at commit
`1a3583bcce77de6d3f8701c0758e3954863681ba`:

https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/1a3583bcce77de6d3f8701c0758e3954863681ba/tests/data/rainbow-451x461.heic

It is used only to prove that the deployment-compatible decoder handles real
HEIC/HEVC bytes. The upstream repository distributes libheif under LGPL-3.0;
see its `COPYING` file for the complete license terms.
